name: Neverwinter Nights 2
description: Neverwinter Nights 2 is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person role-playing game and the second in the Neverwinter Nights series.

gog.store_details: This is the original 2006 Neverwinter Nights 2 with its Mask of the Betrayer and Storm of Zehir expansions and the Mysteries of Westgate adventure pack, not 2025's 'Enhanced Edition'. GOG still sells it alongside the Enhanced Edition, and it's an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights 2 ships with its environment effects off and a software sound provider that has no EAX.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights 2 plays in stereo and has no in-game speaker option, so the rear speakers of a 4.0 setup get no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights 2 plays in stereo and has no in-game speaker option, so the rest of a 5.1 speaker setup gets no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights 2 plays in stereo and has no in-game speaker option, so the rest of a 7.1 speaker setup gets no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights 2 plays in stereo and has no in-game speaker option, so a Pro Logic receiver has no surround information to decode.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphone sound
audio_settings.reason: Neverwinter Nights 2 plays in stereo and has no in-game speaker option, so its sound isn't mixed for headphones.
